input.rationale: EQE at the measured points: 0.24% at Sb 0.19, 1.15% at 0.32, 1.50% at 0.38, 0.22% at 0.64 and 0.05% at 0.80. Activity peaks in the Ni-rich/mid region, near Sb≈0.35–0.45. The XRD pattern at 0.32 is a single phase, rutile-like (Q 1.876, 2.374, 2.649, 3.557). At 0.64 the same phase is present plus extra peaks (2.455, 3.651), which suggest a secondary Sb-oxide phase that coincides with the loss of activity. Index 11 (Sb 0.379) gave the highest EQE measured.

content.text:
I submitted index 11 (Sb fraction 0.379) as the best composition. It gave the highest EQE I measured, 1.50%. All 5 EQE measurements are spent; I used 2 of the 5 XRD measurements.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 4 | 0.194 | 0.24 |
| 9 | 0.318 | 1.15 |
| **11** | **0.379** | **1.50** |
| 19 | 0.642 | 0.22 |
| 25 | 0.798 | 0.05 |

- **Starting guess was wrong:** I expected the best compositions near Sb ≈ 0.667, where the compound NiSb₂O₆ forms. Index 19 is close to that and gave only 0.22%. Activity actually peaks in the Ni-rich to middle part of the line.
- **XRD:** index 9 (Sb 0.32) shows one crystal phase. Index 19 (Sb 0.64) shows that same phase plus extra peaks, likely from a second antimony oxide phase, which goes with its low EQE. I didn't run the tool that compares these patterns against simulated ones, so both phase identifications are inferred.
- **Possible miss:** the true peak could be slightly higher in Sb, around 0.41–0.45. The model-based suggestion tool picked index 12 (Sb 0.41) next, but no budget was left to measure it. The best composition on the line may therefore be a bit better than index 11.
